sections.content: után (after) is a postposition — it follows the noun it governs, unlike English 'after' which comes first: a munka után means 'after work'. kell (is needed / must) is used on its own or with a bare infinitive: pihenés kell means 'rest is needed'.
Word-for-word, a munka után is 'the work after' — Hungarian postpositions trail their noun the way English prepositions lead theirs. Get used to reading them backwards.
